scripts.install:apps: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.cf:types: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('backend/.cloudflare/types', { recursive: true })" && wrangler types backend/.cloudflare/types/index.d.ts --strict-vars=false
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && wrangler dev --env local --local --port 8787
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env "" && wrangler deploy --env ""
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run verify:preview && wrangler d1 migrations apply PREVIEW_DB --remote --config wrangler.preview-migrations.jsonc && wrangler preview
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env local --local
scripts.verify:money: npm run build --prefix backend && node scripts/verify-money.mjs
